power.id: Panglima para malaikat yang disebut wakil Allah atas dunia, pangeran air, pengikat para Pengawas, dan peniup sangkakala kebangkitan; kuasanya ditafsirkan Divine, bukan Cosmic, karena selalu menjalankan perintah Allah.
power.en: Chief of the angels, called viceroy of God over the world, prince of water, binder of the Watchers and sounder of the resurrection trumpet; read as Divine rather than Cosmic because he always acts on God's command.

threat.id: Tradisi mencatat ia menghancurkan pasukan Sanherib dan terpaksa membakar Bait Suci, sehingga cakupan kehancurannya ditafsirkan regional, bukan runtuhnya suatu bangsa.
threat.en: Tradition has him destroy Sennacherib's army and, compelled, set the Temple on fire, so the documented scope is read as regional rather than the collapse of a nation.

fear.id: Membelah batu dengan petir, mengakhiri wabah, dan memanggil jiwa manusia ke penghakiman adalah kuasa di luar hukum alam; ketakutan ini bukan penilaian moral atas sosok pelindung.
fear.en: Splitting rock by lightning, ending a plague and calling souls to judgment are powers beyond natural law; this fear is no moral judgment of a protector.
